The '''RHTT-6 transport''' was a space troopship designed by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]]. It was the basis of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium's]] [[F9-TZ Transport|F9-TZ cloaking transport]].
